name: Maacah
bio: Maacah was the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur, one of David's wives at Hebron, and the mother of his son Absalom (2 Samuel 3:3). As a foreign-born princess, her son Absalom would grow up to be the most strikingly handsome of David's sons — and would later rebel against his father in the aftermath of his sister Tamar's violation, a story told in detail through the rest of 2 Samuel.
